purpose: Resolve every Black-Ink page from universal engines plus a tiny page recipe. Raw manifests store only page-unique facts and explicit exceptions.

page_exceptions.rule: Use only for genuinely page-specific exceptions that cannot live in the monster, environment, archetype, physicality, or universal coloring engines. Empty exception groups are invalid.

derived_fields.coloring_rules: universal defaults.coloring_rules merged only with page_exceptions.coloring_overrides
derived_fields.must_avoid: global_must_avoid + monster must_avoid + environment must_avoid + page_exceptions.avoid_elements

defaults.composition: Portrait coloring page; the monster is the large centered or near-centered dominant focal subject, normally occupying about 60–75% of page height. Keep the full or nearly full silhouette readable. The environment must remain unmistakable using two to four large supporting forms arranged around, behind, or beneath the monster. At least one environmental feature must participate in the story moment. Preserve broad colorable regions, clear silhouette separation, believable grounding, and generous white space.

global_must_avoid: decorative artwork border or inset frame
environment disconnected from the story moment
clutter that obscures monster, habitat, or story beat
accidental hovering or unsupported standing pose
tiny repeated texture that creates coloring homework
non-flying creature shown jumping, falling, dropping, or frozen in midair
chaotic action pose that makes anatomy difficult to read or color

page_uniqueness.rule: Pages may reuse a monster family or environment family, but should not reuse the same resolved combination of subject, place, landmark, framing, interaction, action, and physical state unless intentionally designed as a paired scene.

inheritance_rule: When a universal rule improves, every tome and future book inherits it automatically. Tome manifests store only page-specific recipes and explicit exceptions.

environment_diversity.rule: A concrete environment profile may recur when appropriate, but must not dominate the book. For a 50-page tome, the same profile may appear at most four times. Consecutive use is capped at two pages. Unique landmarks, framing, interaction, and physicality are still required on every occurrence.

locomotion.rule: Coloring pages favor stable natural poses. Non-flying creatures must be visibly supported by the environment and may not be shown falling, jumping, leaping, dropping, hovering, or frozen in midair. Creatures with locomotion.can_fly=true may use controlled natural flight, but the pose must remain calm, readable, and easy to color.

product_scope.repeat_rule: Monster repeats are permitted only when the resolved page recipe is materially different in environment profile, landmark, framing, interaction, moment, and physical state.

approval_gate.rule: All gates must pass before Approve & Lock. Colorability is the first constraint: story may enrich a page but may never reduce coloring usability.

physicality_engine.rule: Every physicality.mode must resolve to exactly one reusable support family. The universal family supplies generic support/weight rules; the page recipe supplies only scene-specific support and motion details.
physicality_engine.coverage_gate: Active-book audit/tests must fail when a used physicality.mode has no universal family or maps to more than one family.
